member.name: T:Text.Str
member.summary: Provides static utility methods for string analysis and manipulation.
member.remarks: The Str class contains static methods for performing common string operations. All methods are static and can be called without creating an instance of the class.

member.name: M:Text.Str.CamelCase(System.String)
member.summary: Counts the number of words in a camelCase string.
member.remarks: In camelCase notation, each word after the first begins with an uppercase letter. This method counts the total number of words by counting uppercase letters and adding one for the initial lowercase word. An empty or null string returns zero.
member.param: A camelCase string. If null or empty, the method returns zero.
member.returns: The number of words in , or zero for null or empty input.
